facts.claim: Good emotional intelligence skills can facilitate undesirable workplace behaviors.
facts.quote: This study is the first to demonstrate that good emotional intelligence skills can facilitate undesirable workplace behaviours.

facts.claim: Children involved in indirect aggression also report high cognitive empathy and lower pro-social behavior.
facts.quote: Mostly children involved in indirect aggression also report high cognitive empathy and have lower pro-social behavior that suggest that some bullies use this cognitive ability to engage in successful acts of manipulation in social groups

facts.claim: Machiavellianism is linked to significant affective empathy deficits.
facts.quote: This review underscores differential empathy profiles across Dark Triad traits, with significant affective empathy deficits in Psychopathy and Machiavellianism

facts.claim: Narcissists are the most likely of the three Dark Triad dimensions to understand others' states of mind to use that knowledge to their advantage.
facts.quote: narcissists would be, among these three dimensions, those most likely to understand others' states of mind and thus be able to use this knowledge to their advantage

facts.claim: In males, both forms of emotional manipulation most strongly correlated with Machiavellianism, followed by narcissism, then psychopathy.
facts.quote: In males, both forms of emotional manipulation most strongly correlated with Machiavellianism, followed by narcissism, then psychopathy.

facts.claim: Narcissism is linked to a negative association with affective empathy (r= -.134, p 2 range: 40.56% - 94.03%).
facts.quote: Meta-analysis showed Narcissism was negatively associated with affective empathy (r= -. 134, p 2 range: 40. 56% - 94. 03%).

research.angle: Individuals with high cognitive empathy and emotional intelligence can use these skills to facilitate manipulation and undesirable behaviors, particularly in social and workplace settings.
research.verdict: The evidence shows that high empathy (specifically cognitive empathy) is linked to manipulation and deceptive behaviors in individuals with Dark Triad traits.
research.caveat: The sources distinguish between cognitive empathy (understanding others) and affective empathy (feeling for others), showing that manipulation is often linked to the former while the latter is often deficient.
